ValueSet-anc-b8-de40.description: JSON Schema for Respiratory exam result - Respiratory exam not done Choices ValueSet codes. Values are represented as Coding objects with 'system' and 'code' properties.
ValueSet-anc-b8-de40.narrative: This schema validates Coding-shaped objects for the Respiratory exam result - Respiratory exam not done Choices ValueSet. Each value must be an object with 'system' (CodeSystem URI) and 'code' (fragment after '#') properties. Display values are available at http://smart.who.int/anc/ValueSet-anc-b8-de40.displays.json. The canonical IRI for a code can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
